Eli (PM): Quick thread: need a compact migration playbook for tenant slicing we can sell as an add-on. Keep it minimal for Q2 EA.
Tess (Runtime): Sketch: rehearsal -> canary -> staged ramp -> full flip. Configurable canary pct.
Omar (SRE): Add: load-test precheck, max-concurrent migrations per region, emergency re-route to shared pool.
Lena (Sales): Customers want a 2hr reservation + optional eng standby 48h. We'll bill for rehearsal too.
Kai (Security): KMS boundary and audit retention checks required. Private deployments get extra checklist.
Tess (Runtime): Minimal YAML example:
```
migrate:
  rehearsal: true
  canary: 5
  stages: [10,25,50,100]
  rollback_if: error_rate>1%
  fallback: shared-pool
```
Omar (SRE): Enforce `max_in_flight` and KV-cache circuit-breaker. Who authorizes rollback? SRE+Runtime lead.
Eli (PM): Launch gate proposal: feature-flagged, SRE capacity reserved, security signoff, docs + sales terms. Gate to Dedicated/Private for EA?
Lena (Sales): Gate yes. Easier to monetize and support.
Kai (Security): Gate yes. Private customers need on-prem validation.
deploy-bot: "router.flags: tenant-slice v1 scheduled for rollout 2026-06-15T09:00:00Z"
Tess (Runtime): Dev estimate: 3 sprints + canary. I'll RFC the atomic routing change.
Eli (PM): OK Ill capture this as EA playbook and follow up with RFC link. Thanks :thumbsup:
